t: A free app for collecting map data in the field on phones and tablets.
steps: Find QField and the QFieldSync plugin on their official sites.
Install QGIS on a teacher computer.
Add the QFieldSync plugin and package a small project.
Ask IT to approve the QField app on school devices.
Install QField on phones or tablets that have GPS.
Copy the project to a device or sync it through QFieldCloud.
Test one field trip on school grounds before the class outing.
